pages.title: Results
pages.text: Results plays at the end of a level in Comix Zone. That's where Sketch Turner gets a super hero rating for how well he's doing, as MobyGames puts it. The song runs about 45 seconds, at about 128 beats a minute.

pages.title: 84 percent on average
pages.text: Comix Zone averages 84% over the 45 reviews collected by Sega Retro. Fusion and the Czech magazine LeveL gave it full marks, and GamePro gave it 75%. GamePro liked the comic book look but warned, "after a few panels, the honeymoon's over."
